[![PNW Cubing Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2QzIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fcd77227d551876bfa5fba1188db32c98f6b91f6/pnw-logos_logo-main.png)]((https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085)) This competition is a "PBQ", or "Please Be Quiet" competition. We will only be holding blindfolded events and Fewest Moves, not traditional events like 3x3. As such, this competition is not recommended for first-time competitors, although you are still welcome. You can find other Washington competitions with more standard event lists [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=washington&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). NOTE: We must have at least 16 competitors in 3BLD to have all three rounds, and 8 competitors must make it to round 2 in order to have the final (as per regulation [9m](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9m)). We may not be able to hold all three rounds if we do not meet the competitor requirements.

items.name: Svealandsmästerskapet 2024
items.information: Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2024#43353-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". ----- Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Svealand Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2024#43353-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". items.name: Benoni Cubing Comeback 2024
items.information: ## SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP A big thanks to Cubestuff who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to [Cubestuff.co.za](https://Cubestuff.co.za) to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. A big thanks to Kitchen Nuvo for sponsoring trophies for our podium placers! Check them out on their Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/worldfocuswood?mibextid=LQQJ4d) to give some support. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.

items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to Denver for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 150 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:00 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (6:00 PM MDT 08-17-2024) This competiton will feature a head-to-head style 3x3 finals! This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

items.name: Qualifying in Kirstenhof 2024
items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce a new Cape Town competition for 2024. This competition is designed as a warmup/rankings qualifier for the [African Championships] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksWCAAfricanChampionship2024) that is coming up in September, so we will have plenty of events and plenty of rounds. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below." ​ ## CHANGES TO THE FORMAT ​ We are wanting to maximise the opportunities for all the cubers in our community and as a result we have decided to make the qualifying criteria for second rounds and finals to be much more achievable. Our goal is to have more people competing in more rounds of solving!! ​ ### SPECTATORS ​ Competitors are welcome to bring 2 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators. ​ ### VOLUNTEERING ​ Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be allocated prior to the event and explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ​ ### LUCKY DRAW ​ During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. ​

items.name: Matatipac Open 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBckdEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f5052380d4840da25b42fdc99bf608f4ab05e628/Matatipac%20Open%202024%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al **Matatipac Open 2024**! Esta emocionante y dinámica competencia se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic el sábado 17 y domingo 18 de agosto de 2024. El Matatipac Open 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de rompecabezas tridimensionales, principalmente eventos no cúbicos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. La competencia incluirá una ronda de Face-Turning Octahedron (FTO), un evento no oficial que promete ser muy emocionante. Además, esta competencia está reconocida oficialmente por la Asociación Mundial del Cubo (WCA). Por lo tanto, es importante que todos los competidores estén familiarizados con el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to the **Matatipac Open 2024**! This exciting and dynamic competition will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, August 17, and Sunday, August 18, 2024. The Matatipac Open 2024 will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of three-dimensional puzzles, primarily non-cubic events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. The competition will include a round of Face-Turning Octahedron (FTO), an unofficial event that promises to be very exciting. Additionally, this competition is officially recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA). Therefore, it is important for all competitors to be familiar with the WCA regulations before the competition.

items.name: BC Championship 2024
items.information: After hosting the Canadian Championship in July 2023, Speedcubing Canada welcomes you back for BC's first Provincial Championship! Note: While everybody is welcome to attend and compete, only BC residents will be eligible for the title of **BC Champion**. For more information, please check out the [Championship Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2024#41375-championship-eligibility). **Please review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You only need to show up for the events that you're competing in - but we encourage you to show up for longer. So, if you are not competing in any events being held on Friday, then you don't need to show up until Saturday. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, so please be ready for each event/round **about 30 minutes in advance**, just in-case. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time. items.information: This competition is part of the [CubingUSA New England Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewEnglandChampionship2024)! First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition, such as the main championship two weeks later. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc05wIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4aee0374f9fb1b92497dd4fc2a791aa6ed8e6ab3/nec2024-logo-384x384.png)

items.information: **This competition is not recommended for first-timers or those looking for a typical competition experience.** This will be a small competition with a selection of uncommon events. We will not be holding typical events like 3x3 and Pyraminx. This competition will be held outdoors and will be weather permitting. We advise against booking any non-refundable travel accommodations in case the competition needs to be cancelled due to inclement weather. There will not be total silence for blindfolded events, but there will be pleasant nature sounds. At most one guest per competitor is permitted. Lunch and dinner for all competitors and guests is included in the registration fee. Please let us know in the registration comments if you have any dietary restrictions.

items.name: Norwegian Championship 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHFKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c60c36a3fbfb1c2f2d10ce4665856be2a51bbe19/Artboard%201.png) ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2024, for første gang holdt i Sandnes! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). ### Staffing Vi kommer til å trenge frivillige som kan bidra med ulike oppgaver under arrangementet. De som bidrar på dette teamet vil få ulike goder, blant annet refundert registreringsavgift. Les [Staffing-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) for mer info. --- ## 🇬🇧 Information Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2024, held in Sandnes for the first time. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab. ### Staffing We are going to need volunteers to help with different tasks during the competition. Those who chose to be a part of this team will get perks such as a refunded registration fee. Read the [Staffing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) tab for more info.

items.information: ##Português: **Atenção:** Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com o delegado (fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org)**. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Caso o limite de 50 competidores não seja atingido, estaremos aceitando inscrições no local pelo preço de R$30, por ordem de chegada. ##English: **Attention:** This competition will have a limit of competitors. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**. In case of withdrawal, please **contact the delegate (fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org)**. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. If the competitor limit of 50 has not been reached, we'll be accepting on the spot registrations for the price of R$30, in order of arrival.

items.information: ## SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. ## NOTICE OF FILMING: Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## VENUE Oppi Dak is situated inside the Gateway Corner Centre. It is located on the first floor right above Liquor City and can be accessed via the stairs or the lift. The venue will provide a variety of food, snacks and drinks on both days and also offer card and cash payment options. On Sunday they also serve a separate Buffet Lunch which you are more than welcome to take part in. Bathroom facilities are available inside the venue, and the Centre itself also provides alternative bathrooms outside of the venue itself. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdE4rIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e2c1c170bf8e893e2b0e882cf48112c0b8251176/CARTEL%20GO%202024.png) **Español** **¡Bienvenidos a Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024!** La Guelaguetza es mucho más que una simple festividad, es el corazón mismo de la cultura oaxaqueña. Representa la esencia de la generosidad, la solidaridad y la comunidad que caracteriza a este hermoso estado de México. En la Guelaguetza, las personas se reúnen para compartir, celebrar y fortalecer los lazos que los unen como comunidad. Y ¿qué mejor manera de expresar esta conexión que a través de los cubos Rubik? Al resolver este rompecabezas, no solo estamos demostrando habilidad y destreza, sino también la capacidad de unirnos en un desafío común, sin importar nuestro origen o cultura. ¡No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de este encuentro único, donde los cubos se convierten en símbolos de conexión y celebración! ¡Te esperamos en la "Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024"! **Inglés** **Welcome to Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024!** Guelaguetza is much more than just a festival; it's the very heart of Oaxacan culture. It represents the essence of generosity, solidarity, and community that characterize this beautiful state of Mexico. During Guelaguetza, people come together to share, celebrate, and strengthen the bonds that unite them as a community. And what better way to express this connection than through Rubik's Cubes? By solving this puzzle, we're not only showcasing skill and dexterity but also the ability to come together in a common challenge, regardless of our background or culture. Don't miss the chance to be part of this unique gathering, where Rubik's Cubes become symbols of connection and celebration! We look forward to seeing you at "Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024"!

items.information: Chào mừng các bạn đến với giải đấu vô địch quốc gia Vietnam Championship 2024! Giải Vietnam Championship lần này sẽ có toàn bộ các bộ môn thi đấu, với nhiều môn thi đấu có từ 2 đến 4 vòng. Xem thêm thông tin tại các tab. # Điều kiện tham dự thi Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5 Các thí sinh tham dự các nội dung **Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5** phải đạt điều kiện sau: * Thí sinh phải có **ít nhất một lượt** Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 thành công. * Kết quả Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 tốt nhất của thí sinh đạt **Top 20** trong số các thí sinh đã đăng ký thi nội dung tương ứng. Các thí sinh không đạt những điều kiện này sẽ **không được tham dự thi** các nội dung tương ứng và sẽ được hoàn 100% lệ phí các môn này (nếu đã nộp). # Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh Ban tổ chức và/hoặc các hãng truyền thông tại giải đấu có thể sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh làm tư liệu về giải đấu. Bằng cách có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, **bạn công nhận rằng bạn đã được thông báo về việc quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu, và hiểu rõ rằng tư liệu hình ảnh này sẽ được sử dụng cho mọi mục đích cần thiết của Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan. Bạn đồng thời cũng đồng ý cho phép Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan toàn quyền vĩnh viễn sử dụng những hình ảnh có diện mạo và/hoặc giọng nói của bạn cho mọi mục đích cần thiết.** Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu. ________________________________________________________________ We warmly welcome you to Vietnam Championships 2024! This year's Vietnam Championship will offer all events, many of which will be offering 2 to 4 rounds. Refer to the tabs for more information. # Qualification Criteria for 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded Competitors in **4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded** must meet the following qualification criteria: * The competitor must have **at least one** successful 3x3x3 Blindfolded result. * The competitor's best 3x3x3 Blindfolded result must be within the **Top 20** of all registered competitors of the respective event. Competitors who fail to meet these criteria will **not be allowed to compete in the respective event** and will receive a full refund of any event fees for the events (if already paid). # Notice on Filming and Photography The organizers and/or present media companies may perform filming and photography at the competition for usage as photographic material of the competition. By being present at the competition premises, **you acknowledge that you have been duly informed of any filming and photography that might take place at the competition, and fully acknowledge that the material may be used for any and all necessary purposes by the Vietnam Cube Association (VNCA) and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors. You also grant full, perpetual consent for VNCA and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors to use video and photographic material that contains your likeness and/or voice for any and all necessary purposes.** If you do not agree with the above terms, please do not be present at the competition premises. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBclJwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2901c91547887dda589a7979741476bc143c0896/vietnamcube%20(1).png)

items.name: Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa05zIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c3e44aec5cbb0ee93127339ad0d85620fe1e8c43/All-Star%202024%20Logo.png) ## Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) and [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/) are excited to team up with [Rubik's](https://rubiks.com) and [Spin Master](https://www.spinmaster.com) to bring speedcubing all-stars together for an official WCA competition at the Mall of America® in Bloomington, Minnesota! ## Qualification To qualify to register for this competition, you must have an official sub-7.00 3x3x3 average. This result must have occurred at a competition that took place on or before March 21, 2024. If you don't qualify for this competition, look for one of the many other opportunities to compete in the Midwest area, including [Minnesota Warm Up 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaWarmUp2024) on July 13 and July 14, also being held at the Mall of America! We also invite you to watch Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 via the livestream, or if you are in the area stop by the Mall of America® and watch it live! ## Spectators and Livestream We're thrilled to put competitive speedcubing on display via the Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 livestream. See the Livestream tab for more details. The event will be open to in-person spectators who will be able to view this competition from mulitple levels of the Mall of America®, including on the jumbotron that will be projected in the Huntington Bank Rotunda. Reserved VIP seating will also be available for up to two guests for each competitor. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of the Rubik's North America All-Stars 2024 competition consent to their images being used by Midwest Cubing Association and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ##Português: **Competidores, atenção aos seguintes avisos:** - Esta competição contará *apenas com a modalidade* ***Clock*** ; - A competição ocorrerá no período da manhã, no mesmo dia e local que o Rubik's WCA South American Championship FMC 2024 (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SACFMC2024). Consulte a página da competição para mais detalhes; - O competidor se desejar poderá se inscrever em uma ou nas duas competições. Cada competição tem seu custo de inscrição. Caso o competidor queira se inscrever nas duas competições, deverão ser pagas as ***duas taxas de inscrição.*** Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **Caso o limite de 35 competidores não seja atingido, estaremos aceitando inscrições no local pelo preço de R$20, por ordem de chegada** ##English: **Competitors, heed the following warnings:** - This competition will *only have* the ***Clock*** event; - The competition will take place in the morning on the same day and place as Rubik's WCA South American Championship FMC 2024 (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SACFMC2024). See the competition page for more details; - The competitor, if they wish, can enroll in one or both competitions. Each competition has its registration cost. If the competitor wants to register for both competitions, the ***two registration fees must be paid.*** For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0Y5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cb6d356bf5594b0c88d80b79f9ce71c51f373a9e/5adbd2ae-6772-4ce6-9aab-d590f0ad777b.jpg) To Athens TableTop Open 2024 είναι ο 6ος διαγωνισμός της WCA στην Ελλάδα για το 2024. Ο διαγωνισμός γίνεται στις 7 Ιουλίου 2024 στο κλειστό Ολυμπιακό γήπεδο του Τάεκβοντο στην Αθήνα στο Δέλτα Φαλήρου κατά την διάρκεια του Φεστιβάλ Επιτραπέζιων Παιχνιδιών [Athens Tabletop](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/). Το Athens TableTop Open 2024 τελεί υπό την αιγίδα της WCA και διοργανώνεται από το ηλεκτρονικό κατάστημα [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) , την [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) και την [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/), οι οποίες ανήκουν στην εταιρεία [Καινοτομίες Βερδέ ΑΕΒΕ](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste). Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε για μια μοναδική εμπειρία και γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τόσο την παρούσα σελίδα όσο και τις επόμενες σελίδες Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί **το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA KAI να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντίτιμου συμμετοχής όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα** . Επίσης, για την είσοδό σας στον χώρο θα χρειαστεί **ξεχωριστό εισιτήριο για την έκθεση** αξίας 8 ευρώ για μία μέρα ή 14 για το διήμερο, το οποίο σας παρέχει πρόσβαση σε όλο τον χώρο της έκθεσης, όπου μπορείτε να γνωρίσετε τόσο τα προϊόντα μας, όσο και πολλών ακόμα εκθετών. Εισιτήρια για το φεστιβάλ θα βρείτε εδώ [εδώ.](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/tickets2024/) [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RS768gK0Vrg&feature=youtu.be) Σημείωση Αποδοχής κινηματογράφησης ή φωτογράφισης. Οι διαγωνιζόμενοι και οι συμμετέχοντες με την συμμετοχή τους στο Athens TableTop Open 2024 αυτόματα συμφωνούν με την πιθανή χρήση των εικόνων τους από τους διοργανωτές σε προωθητικές ενέργειες, κοινωνικά δίκτυα και άλλες ψηφιακές ενέργειες. Οι online εγγραφές ανοίγουν στη 1η Ιουνίου 2024 και κλείνουν στις 30 Ιουνίου 2024. Athens Tabletop Open 2024 is the 6th WCA Competition in Greece during 2024. The competition is taking place on the 7th of July during the Festival of Board Games ["Athens Tabletop"](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/?lang=en), at the [Athens Tae Kwon Do Stadium](https://www.facebook.com/taekwondofaliro/), which is located in the Faliron Delta of Athens. Athens Tabletop Open 2024 is an official WCA competition and is co-organized from the e-shop [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) , [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) and [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/), all of which are subsidiaries of [Verdes innovations S.A](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste) . Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules and come for an unforgettable experience and celebration of cubing! Please read the following and the rest of the tabs very carefully. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should **both register though the WCA site AND pay the registration fee** as described in the adjacent tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information. Additionally, for entry to the venue, **a separate ticket for the exhibition is required,** costing 8 euros for one day or 14 euros for two days. This ticket provides access to the entire exhibition area, where you can explore both our products and those of many other exhibitors. Festival tickets available through [this link.](https://www.tabletopcon.gr/tickets2024/) Notice of Acceptance for Filming or Photography Competitors and other Attendees of Athens Tabletop Open 2024 consent to their images being used by the organizers and its partners in marketing and promotional actions and materials, social media and other digital platforms. Online registration open 01.06.2024 and close 30.06.2024.

items.information: Varmt välkomna till denna 24-timmarstävling i Åkers Styckebruk! Därför passar tävlingen sannolikt inte varken nya eller yngre deltagare särskilt bra. Therefore, the competition probably does not suit neither new or younger participants very well. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information, especially the [concept tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/24HoursinAker2024#43667-koncept-concept). items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdlo2IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--0981036a30347f039f2f8369d2f3c11a6625373f/LOGO_TORNEO_LOS_FUERTES.jpg) ##### Español **¡Bienvenidos a Los Fuertes Puebla 2024!** Puebla, la ciudad donde la grandeza se encuentra entre volcanes, se está preparando para recibirte en un próximo torneo y poner a prueba tus habilidades. ¿Qué tan fuerte podrás llegar? ¡Esto es un reto contra ti mismo! *¿Sabías que...?* El triángulo se considera la figura geométrica más fuerte. Cuando piensas en los volcanes, ¿qué categoría viene a tu mente? Así es como Pyraminx representa diferentes aspectos de este torneo. Estamos seguros que no esperabas tremendas referencias con el nombre, el lugar y nuestra categoría principal. Y aún hay más, ¡échale un vistazo a los detalles y verás la fusión! Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Los Fuertes Puebla 2024 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ##### English **¡Welcome to Los Fuertes Puebla 2024!** Puebla, the city where greatness lies among volcanoes, is gearing up to welcome you to an upcoming competition and test your skills. How strong will you be able to become? This is a challenge against yourself! *Did you know...?* That triangle is considered the strongest geometric shape. When thinking about volcanoes, which is the category that comes to your mind? This is how Pyraminx represents different aspects of this competition. We're sure you weren't expecting such remarkable references between the name, location and our main event. And there's still more, take a look at the details and you'll see the fusion! This competition is possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Los Fuertes Puebla 2024 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.name: Please Be Clocked Cape Town 2024
items.information: ## Information [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce Please Be Clocked Cape Town 2024! This competition has a full array of blindfolded events, with Clock and 5x5 to mix things up. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket. Please see payment details below. **Important** - if we do not have enough competitors to hold 3x3 Blindfolded Round 2, we will adjust the schedule to have 2 Rounds of 5x5 instead. **PLEASE NOTE** This competition does NOT have 3x3 or other popular events like 2x2 or Pyraminx. If you are a newcomer, please do not register unless you are able to solve cubes Blindfolded or would like to participate in the 5x5 or Clock events. ## SPECTATORS Spectators are only allowed as companions to competitors. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with **volunteering** during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". If any competitor or competitor's guests are willing to help judge with the blindfolded events, especially Multiple Blindfolded, please let us know. If you are able to assist with judging the longer events (4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and Multiple Blindfolded), we will reward you with a free coffee, chocolate, or other small gift :) #### About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you are able to assist in any way and want to get involved, please get in touch [here](https://cubingza.org/contact)!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2syIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--421be8dcbd6a4e0e29893d46b60668a278a829ce/image.png) * This is the second speedcubing competition recognized by the WCA in Nuuk! * The competition happens on Sunday June 23rd but a workshop will happen on Saturday 22nd from 16 to 19. Join us for a good time with other cubers, to learn new techniques and be ready for timing yourself on Sunday afternoon! * The competition is a fun way to time yourself and have official results recognized by the World Cube Association! You will be called to do 5 timed solves, your best time and worst times are removed and your ranking is determined by the average of the 3 remaining times! All you need is to be able to solve the cube in less than 10 minutes, we will help you with this during the workshop! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1kyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--050293ccbaf021bc31fec3d8a961df60e1d36ac7/image.png) * Una Nuummi Speedcubing-imik unamminerup aappassaraa World Cube Association-imiit akuerisaq! * Unammineq sapaammi 23. juni ualikkut nal. 13:10-19:45 piumaarpoq, pinnginneranilu pikkorissarneq arfiningornermi 22. juni nal. 16:00 19:00 aamma sapaammi 23. juni nal. 12-13 ingerlanneqassalluni. Piffissami nuannersumi peqatigisigut, allanik aamma cubertartunik peqataasoqarumaarpoq. Periusinik nutaanik ilinniarit, imminullu piffissalersornissannut sapaammi. * Unamminermi nuannersumik imminut piffissalersussaatit inerniliussallu World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaasussaassallutik. Tallimariarlutit piffissalersussaatit, pitsaanerpaaq ajornerpaarlu peerpata sinneruttut pingasut inernerisa agguaqatigiisinnera unamminermi inissitsiternermi sumiinnersutit inissikkumaarlugu. Anguniagaq tassaaginnarpoq minutsit qulit iluanni terningip naammassisinnaanngornissaa. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2cyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3511d693f3962fa6f0a96bf67ebafa277e88e75e/image.png) * Dette er den anden speedcubing konkurrence som er anerkendt af World Cube Association i Nuuk! * Konkurrencen finder sted søndag den 23. juni om eftermiddagen kl.13:10-19:45 , før konkurrencen vil der være en workshop lørdag den 22. fra kl. 16-19 og søndag fra kl.12-13. Tag med os til en god tid sammen med andre cubers, for at lære nye teknikker og være klar til at time dig selv søndag eftermiddag. * Konkurrencen er en sjov måde at time dig selv og få officielle resultater anerkendt af World Cube Association! Du vil blive kaldt til at lave 5 tidsbestemte løsninger, din bedste tid og værste tider fjernes, og din placering bestemmes af gennemsnittet af de 3 resterende gange! Det eneste du skal bruge er at kunne løse kuben på under 10 minutter, det hjælper vi dig med under workshoppen!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbHg3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--24c36c7429ebfb000d0e3d5923abffb184db306d/Cubo%20m%C3%A1gico%20cartaz%20(1).jpg)![] 🇧🇷 O Cubo Mágico, inventado pelo professor de arquitetura húngaro Ernő Rubik, comemora seu 50º aniversário neste ano. Por ocasião deste jubileu, o Consulado-Geral da Hungria e a Associação Brasiliense de Cubo Mágico organizam conjuntamente uma competição comemorativa do inconfundível quebra-cabeça. Venha, participe, desafie-se! Esta competição será gratuita. Para se inscrever, vá para a aba "Inscrever". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). --- 🇺🇸 The Rubik’s Cube, invented by Hungarian architecture professor Ernő Rubik, celebrates its 50th anniversary this year. On the occasion of this jubilee, the Consulate General of Hungary in Sao Paulo and the Brazilian Magic Cube Association jointly organizes a competition celebrating the world famous puzzle. Join us, participate, and challenge yourself! This competition will be free. To register, go to the tab "Register". If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

items.information: ### 시리즈별 대회장이 다릅니다. 주의하세요. ### A대회 : 세미나실 1 ### B, C대회 : 세미나실 3 ### 본 대회는 시리즈 대회의 일환으로, 시리즈 대회 중 하나의 대회에만 참가할 수 있습니다. 관련 안내 사항을 [시리즈 대회 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaQualifierDaeguA2024#43995-about-the-series-competitions)에서 확인 바랍니다. ### 대회 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대회 참가가 불가능합니다. ### 참가 확정 / 대기 명단은 3일 내로 갱신되니, 참가 신청 이후 명단에서 본인의 이름을 확인해 주시기를 바랍니다. ### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 참가비 납부는 [대회 신청 및 참가비 납부](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaQualifierDaeguA2024#43887-registration-and-payment-details) 탭을 눌러 확인해주세요. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. ___ ### Series competitions have different venues. Please see [Registration and Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaQualifierDaeguA2024#43887-registration-and-payment-details) tab for registration fee information. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). items.name: Summer in Bishkek 2024
items.information: Русский Summer in Bishkek 2024 - это открытый чемпионат по скоростной сборке головоломок в городе Бишкек. Базовый регистрационный взнос за 1 дисциплину составляет 200 сом. За 2 или более дисциплин взнос составляет 700 сом. Данные соревнования организованы при поддержки команды QBERS. 10 процетов от всех собранных средств будут отправлены в международную благотворительную организацию "Интеракт" Кыргызча Summer in Bishkek 2024 — Бишкек шаарында өтүүчү пазлдарды жогорку ылдамдыкта чогултуу боюнча ачык чемпионат. 1 дисциплинага негизги каттоо төлөмү 200 сом. 2 же андан көп дисциплиналар үчүн төлөм 700 сомду түзөт. Бул мелдештер QBERS командасынын колдоосу менен уюштурулууда. Бардык чогултулган каражаттардын 10 пайызы "Интеракт" эл аралык кайрымдуулук уюмуна жөнөтүлөт English Summer in Bishkek 2024 is an open championship in high-speed puzzle assembly in the city of Bishkek. The basic registration fee for 1 discipline is 200 soms. For 2 or more disciplines the fee is 700 soms. These competitions are organized with the support of the QBERS team. 10 percent of all funds raised will be sent to the international charity organization "Interact"

items.name: Oslo Open 2024
items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2024! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnA1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--07e81cdd5b508271bf1d27c0c873b462bead0340/image.png) **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Α μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. Ο 3x3 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα 2x2 και OH ή Pyraminx και Skewb επιθυμείτε. Πέντε διαγωνισμοί για τα μισά του 2024 δεν είναι αρκετοί. Απλά δεν είναι! Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα για ακόμα μία φορά στον γνωστό πλέον χώρο του Rubicon. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Athens Summer Break A 2024. ** Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 2x2 * OH, επίλυση 3x3 με ένα χέρι Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. items.information: (SRB) Belgrade Summer 2024 je dvadeseto po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. **Cena kotizacije za ovo takmičenje zavisi od toga koliko dana se takmičite. Ukoliko se takmičite oba dana plaćate punu cenu od 2,000RSD, ali ukoliko se takmičite samo 1 dan plaćate 50% iznosa. Ovo nije standardna praksa i ovo pravilo važi samo za ovo takmičenje.** ------------------------ (ENG) Belgrade Summer 2024 is the 20th speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. **Registration fee for this competition depends on how many days you are competing on. If you are competing on both days you will pay the full fee of 2,000RSD, but if you are competing only on one day you will pay 50%. This is not a standard practice, and this rule applies only to this competition.**

items.information: ## Information [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce Big & Blind Pretoria 2024! This competition is focused on the the bigger NxNs like 5x5, 6x6 and 7x7 and blind events! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket. Please see payment details below. If you are competing in multi-blind, please make sure to arrive between 07:30-07:45 for cube submission. ## SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". If any competitor or competitor's guest is willing to help judge with the blind events, especially multi-blind, please let us know. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.name: Ilulissat 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2syIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--421be8dcbd6a4e0e29893d46b60668a278a829ce/image.png) * This is the first speedcubing competition recognized by the WCA in Ilulissat! * The competition happens on Saturday 15 June in the afternoon (13 to 16), but a workshop will happen the morning (9 ti 12) and the day before, Friday 14 from 13 to 17. Join us for a good time with other cubers, to learn new techniques and be ready for timing yourself on Saturday afternoon! * The competition is a fun way to time yourself and have official results recognized by the World Cube Association! You will be called to do 5 timed solves, your best time and worst times are removed and your ranking is determined by the average of the 3 remaining times! All you need is to be able to solve the cube in less than 10 minutes, we will help you with this during the workshop! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1kyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--050293ccbaf021bc31fec3d8a961df60e1d36ac7/image.png) * Una Ilulissani speedcubingimik unammisitsineq siullerpaajuvoq World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaq! * Unammineq arfininngornermi 15. juni ualikkut nal. 13:00-16:00 piumaarpoq, pinnginneranilu pikkorissarneq tallimanngornermi 14. juni nal. 13:00-17:00 aamma arfininngornermi 15. juni nal. 09:00-12:00 ingerlanneqassalluni. Piffissami nuannersumi peqatigisigut, allanik aamma cubertartunik peqataasoqarumaarpoq. Arfininngornermi ualikkut periutsinik nutaanik ilinniarnissannut nuannersumut peqatigisigut Cube-ertartut allat peqatigalugit, imminullu time-lersornermut piareersarlutit. * Unamminermi nuannersumik imminut piffissalersussaatit inerniliussallu World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaasussaassallutik. Tallimariarlutit aggeqqutissaatit piffissalersussallutillu, angusanni pitsaanerpaaq ajornerpaarlu ilanngaatigeriarlugit sinneruttut pingasut inernerisa agguaqatigiisinnerat unamminermi inissitsiternermi sumiinnersutit inissinneqarumaarpoq. Anguniagaq tassaaginnarpoq minutsit qulit iluanni terning-ip naammassisinnaanngornissaa, tamanna pillugu pikkorissanermi ikiorumaarpatsigit. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2cyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3511d693f3962fa6f0a96bf67ebafa277e88e75e/image.png) * Dette er den første speedcubing konkurrence som er anerkendt af World Cube Association i ilulissat! * Konkurrencen finder sted lørdag den 15. juni om eftermiddagen kl. 13:00-16:00, før konkurrencen vil der være en workshop fredag den 14. fra kl. 13:00-17:00 og lørdag fra kl. 09:00-12:00. Tag med os til en god tid sammen med andre cubers, for at lære nye teknikker og være klar til at time dig selv lørdag eftermiddag. * Konkurrencen er en sjov måde at time dig selv og få officielle resultater anerkendt af World Cube Association! Du vil blive kaldt til at lave 5 tidsbestemte løsninger, din bedste tid og værste tider fjernes, og din placering bestemmes af gennemsnittet af de 3 resterende gange! Det eneste du skal bruge er at kunne løse kuben på under 10 minutter, det hjælper vi dig med under workshoppen!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0Z0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b0b41adcf5d4f6f1ea7f7c8838508e1b81430c53/1.png) # **SeaHorse Vallarta 2024** **Español** ¡Bienvenidos a SeaHorse Vallarta 2024, la primera competencia celebrada en Puerto Vallarta! Es un honor darles la bienvenida a este emocionante evento donde los aficionados al cubo de Rubik de diversas partes del país podran convivir en este bello puerto y poder demostrar sus habilidades y rapidez. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **Ingles** ¡Welcome to SeaHorse Vallarta 2024, the first competition held in Puerto Vallarta! It is an honor to welcome you to this exciting event where Rubik Cube fans from different parts of the country will be able to coexist in this beautiful port and demonstrate their skills and speed. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition.

items.name: Trondheim Friends 2024
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Trondheim Friends 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024#44248-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Trondheim Friends 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for this competition. We strongly advise all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024#44248-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBclp5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3eb495a7327c9da34d21481bc68870f97c1e03ae/image.png) Inscrição de competidor: R$ 50,00 **Por se tratar de um local com tamanho limitado, será permitido apenas um convidado por competidor, sem a possibilidade de adição de novos convidados** Limite de competidores: 40 ​ ​ Registration fee: R$ 50,00 **As the venue has a limited size, it will be permitted a single guest per competitor, without any possibility of the addition of other guests.** Competitor limit: 40 ​ ​ REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos, sem o cumprimento destes, a inscrição não será aceita: ​ Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA; Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicando o nome completo do participante. Detalhes sobre o pagamento da inscrição abaixo. ​ Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Há um limite de 40 competidores Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com). ​ Para os competidores menores de idade que forem ficar desacompanhados durante o período da noite, será necessário o envio de uma autorização de um pai ou responsável autorizando a permanência após este horário. Esta é uma competição de 24 horas e portanto atente-se a isso. Caso não possa ficar as 24 horas, não há necessidade, preze pela sua saúde e bem-estar mental. REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements, without fulfilling these requirements, the registration will not be accepted: ​ Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name. More details about the payment below; ​ Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. There will be a limit of 40 competitors. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) To underage competitors that will stay alone during the night period, it will be requested an express authorization of a parent or guardian authorizing the competitor's participation during said period. This is a 24 hour competition, therefore, be attentive to that. In case you're not able to stay the 24 hours, there is no need to, value your health and mental well-being.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdXB0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--12c29642a2fc1a7776803f30970bc62ffd4c6ceb/CuceiOpen_2%20(1).png) 10 años despues de la primera competencia en las instalaciones de CUCEI, **¡volvemos con el CUCEI Open 2024!** Esta es la 11va competencia oficial en el estado de Jalisco, en la cual buscamos conmemorar un poco sobre la historia del speedcubing en las tierras del tequila. items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Summer 2024 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich, Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Florian Truckenthanner, Pranjal Khan und Viktor Kalmar. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Summer 2024 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich, Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Florian Truckenthanner, Pranjal Khan and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0J4IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2702a39ca2f45a9b8086d0b54cb406344f0c2b05/logo_cubolympics.png) ### PORTUGUÊS Sejam bem-vindos ao **Rio Cubolympics 2024**! Será um prazer recebê-los. **Dicas:** - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos **30 minutos** antes de **modalidade que participará**; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! ### ENGLISH Welcome to **Rio Cubolympics 2024**! It will be a pleasure to welcome you. **Tips:** - Arrive at the competition location at least **30 minutes** before **the category you will participate in**; - The cube you will compete with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers. Have a lot of fun!

items.name: Katerini Beach Open 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbFZ1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--832ba1051dbfb958a61c53d310fdebb0b82e9442/image.png) Συνεχίζουμε τη συναρπαστική σειρά των διαγωνισμών για το 2024 με το 'Katerini Beach Open 2024', τον 4ο διαγωνισμό της χρονιάς. Αυτή τη φορά πηγαίνουμε βόρεια, στην ξακουστή παραλία της Κατερίνης, δίπλα στο κύμα! Στο συνεδριακό κέντρο του ξενοδοχείου Mediterranean Village θα συναντηθούμε με την φιλοδοξία να πραγματοποιηθεί ένα από τα μεγαλύτερα αν όχι το μεγαλύτερο έως τώρα OPEN της Ελλάδας! Σε ένα μοναδικό Σαββατοκύριακο, με άρωμα από το επερχόμενο ελληνικό καλοκαίρι, όλοι οι συμμετέχοντες θα απολαύσουν το πάθος τους για το cubing σε έναν ιδανικό προορισμό. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας (και τα μαγιό σας) και ελάτε να γιορτάσουμε μαζί την αγάπη για το cubing σε ένα αμιγώς ελληνικό τοπίο! Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε όλες τις καρτέλες για να βρείτε τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) We continue the exciting series of competitions for 2024 with the 'Katerini Beach Open 2024', the 4th competition of the year. This time we go north, to the famous beach of Katerini, by the sea! In the conference center of the Mediterranean Village hotel & SPA we will meet again with the ambition to hold one of the biggest, if not the biggest, OPEN in Greece! In a unique weekend, with the aroma of the upcoming Greek summer, all participants will enjoy their passion for cubing in an ideal destination. Grab your cubes (and your swimsuits) and come celebrate the love of cubing together in a purely Greek landscape! Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

[![PNW Cubing Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2QzIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fcd77227d551876bfa5fba1188db32c98f6b91f6/pnw-logos_logo-main.png)]((https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085)) This competition is a "PBQ", or "Please Be Quiet" competition. We will only be holding blindfolded events and Fewest Moves, not traditional events like 3x3. As such, this competition is not recommended for first-time competitors, although you are still welcome. You can find other Washington competitions with more standard event lists [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=washington&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). NOTE: We must have at least 16 competitors in 3BLD to have all three rounds, and 8 competitors must make it to round 2 in order to have the final (as per regulation [9m](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9m)). We may not be able to hold all three rounds if we do not meet the competitor requirements.

items.information: CubingZA is excited to announce the third Cape Town competition for 2024, and the first to be held in the Northern Suburbs! This competition will focus on a variety of shorter, popular events, with multiple rounds of 3x3, 2x2, and Pyraminx, as well as one round of 4x4 and Skewb. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and pay for your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. **SPECTATORS** Competitors are welcome to bring up to two spectators with them. **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). **About CubingZA** CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more! If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please get in touch by contacting us [here](https://cubingza.org/contact).

Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024). Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare. ----- Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. This year there will be a 3-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024). We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

items.name: BF Vienna Day 2024
items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr, euch BF Vienna Day 2024 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert und delegiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Viktor Kalmar. Diesesmal findet das Turnier in den Räumlichkeiten des BMME statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier herzlich willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the BF Vienna Day 2024 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised and delegated by Florian Truckenthanner and Viktor Kalmar. The results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

items.name: Örebro Side Events 2024
items.information: Välkomna till den första tävlingen någonsin i Örebro! Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Detta är också en utmärkt möjlighet att delta på [FMC-SM](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024), som hålls dagen efter och det finns möjlighet att tävla i Örebro. Däremot är platserna begränsade till sju deltagare, så anmäl dig snarast om du är sugen! Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to the first competition ever in Örebro! Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. This is also an excellent opportunity to participate in the [Swedish FMC Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024) which is held the day after, and it's possible to compete in Örebro. There is however a 7-person limit, so make sure to grab a spot soon if you're interested! We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: Ottawa Spring 2024
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ### (EN) ### Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). For new competitors, this video may help with competing. https://youtu.be/vz1V0Gv0qX0?si=7y524qUInNbtHtVz Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### (FR) ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les concurrents doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition, vous pouvez consulter le [Tutoriel de la compétition de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf). Pour les nouveaux concurrents, cette vidéo peut les aider à participer à la compétition. https://youtu.be/vz1V0Gv0qX0?si=7y524qUInNbtHtVz Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ## Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Wendlinger Würfelwochenende 2024
items.information: Nach über einem Jahrzehnt kehrt endlich eine Speedcubing Competition nach Wendlingen zurück. Speedcuber dürfen sich auf Spannung, Rekorde und eine leidenschaftliche Gemeinschaft freuen. After more than a decade, a speedcubing competition is finally returning to Wendlingen. Speedcubers can look forward to excitement, records and a passionate community.

items.name: Stockholmsligan 432: Fel Färg i Ankeborg - 2024
items.information: Varmt välkomna till den sjätte deltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet (eller tidigare deltagande i serien). Mer information om Stockholmligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. **OBS:** På grund av helgdag (1:a maj) så börjar första grenen klockan **15:40** - *inte* 17:40 som annars. Det betyder också att tävlingen kommer sluta drygt 19:00 istället för 21:00. -- A warm welcome to the sixth competition in the spring season of Stockholmsligan 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** Due to a Swedish public holiday (1st of May), the first event will start at **3:40 PM** - *not* 5:40 PM as usual. This also means that the competition will finish at around 7 PM instead of 9 PM.

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce a new Cape Town competition for 2024. This comp will focus on the original cube, the **3x3x3**, and the varying ways to solve it - with **two hands, one-handed, blindfolded**, and in the **fewest moves**; and we will round out the events with some **2x2, 4x4,** and **Megaminx**. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below." ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring 2 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more! If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact).

items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Trondheim Spring 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024#40829-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Trondheim Spring 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024#40829-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.
